targets.review_note: Sort by one rating. Higher entries always reach lower entries; an inversion of the other rating links its entire interval into one strongly connected component. A boundary exists exactly when the prefix maximum of the other rating is below the suffix minimum. Each component reaches itself and all earlier components.
